{{Quote|Starfighters changing vector. Breaking into two elements. Flying the imprint of the Nebula Front.|The Sullustan comtechnician to [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]]|<ref name="CoD" /> }}
This '''individual''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who served as a communications technician for [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]] on the bridge of the ''[[Revenue]]'',  a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]].<ref name="CoD" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]] and his crew infiltrated the ship. The Sullustan, Dofine and the rest of crew escaped to the [[Acquisitor (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Acquisitor'']], which arrived in the [[Dorvalla system/Legends|Dorvalla system]] as reinforcement.<ref name="CoD" />
